diagnosis: The checks C1, C2, C3, and C4 passed because the lone decision-maker used the public facts PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4, respectively, which were required to determine the exact blocks for each activity. Since the model always schedules activities within the exact blocks specified by these public facts, it did not need any hidden information to satisfy the checks.

C2.why: The custodian and technician availability changes the clinic refrigeration transfer to the exact 1000-1200 block.

C3.why: The stabilized-output and technician requirement changes the communications-battery recharge to the exact 1200-1400 block.

C4.why: The manifold-connection sequence changes water-point pumping to the exact final block, 1400-1600.
